close_reason: Superseded by PKIX-q1nf (closed in commit a15f2485). pkix-path now exposes pub fn cert_is_ca returning Result<bool, DerError>; pkix-path-builder::cert_is_ca and pkix-revocation::crl::cert_is_ca_cert are both thin wrappers calling it. The DRY violation tracked here is fixed; the local OID_BASIC_CONSTRAINTS const in pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs has been removed.
description:
pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:479-491 and pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:126-138

Both `pkix-revocation::crl` and `pkix-path-builder` contain nearly identical functions that extract `BasicConstraints.cA` from a certificate:

In crl.rs (lines 479-491):
```rust
fn cert_is_ca_cert(cert: &Certificate) -> bool {
    use x509_cert::ext::pkix::BasicConstraints;
    cert.tbs_certificate
        .extensions.as_deref().unwrap_or(&[])
        .iter().find(|e| e.extn_id == OID_BASIC_CONSTRAINTS)
        .and_then(|e| BasicConstraints::from_der(e.extn_value.as_bytes()).ok())
        .map(|bc| bc.ca)
        .unwrap_or(false)
}
```

In pkix-path-builder/lib.rs (lines 126-138):
```rust
fn cert_is_ca(cert: &Certificate) -> bool {
    // nearly identical implementation
}
```

This logic is also effectively duplicated in `pkix-path` itself (chain_walk's NotCA check). 

Since `pkix-revocation` already depends on `pkix-path`, the cleanest fix would be to expose a `pub(crate)` or `pub` helper from `pkix-path` (e.g., `cert_basic_constraints()` or `is_ca_cert()`), avoiding three independent copies of the same OID-lookup + DER-decode pattern.

Alternatively, accept the duplication but ensure all three copies use the same logic (e.g., consistent fail-open semantics on decode errors).
notes: Three-crate refactoring of a helper function. Deferred to v0.2. Each copy is internally consistent.
title: crl.rs: cert_is_ca_cert duplicates pkix-path-builder cert_is_ca — share via pkix-path re-export
